course.title: Sign Language Basics
course.tagline: Learn the signs for everyday words and hold a basic conversation.

days.title: What is sign language?
days.goal: Say what sign language is and how it works.

video.title: 25 ASL Signs You Need to Know

steps: Watch today's video and copy each sign for what sign language is: hands, face and body slowly in front of a mirror.
Practise what sign language is: hands, face and body for 10 minutes, signing each item three times in a row.
Fingerspell or sign five of your own examples of what sign language is: hands, face and body without looking at the video.
Record yourself signing what sign language is: hands, face and body and check your handshape, movement and facial expression.
Sign what sign language is: hands, face and body to a friend or family member today and ask them to guess the meaning.
days.task: Watch a short signed chat and write down three things you notice.
days.challenge: Learn the sign for hello and use it today.

quiz.q: What does sign language use to talk?
options: Hands, face and body.
Voice only.
Written words only.
Sounds and music.
quiz.explain: Sign language uses hands, face and body. The face is part of the grammar, not just feeling.

quiz.q: Which of these is the goal of today's lesson?
options: Sign a short greeting chat.
Say what sign language is and how it works.
Sign mother, father, sister and brother.
Sign red, blue, green, yellow, black and white.
quiz.explain: Today's lesson is about What is sign language? — its goal is: Say what sign language is and how it works.

quiz.q: Which of these did today's lesson focus on?
options: fingerspelling the letters O to Z
signing yes, no, maybe and I do not know
signing time words
what sign language is: hands, face and body
quiz.explain: Today's focus was what sign language is: hands, face and body.
